display.purpose: The TasteVault wordmark and nothing else at full scale; warm chunky old-style serif, capped at 6rem, line-height 0.9, tracking -0.01em. The 'Vault' half is set in the cobalt accent.

headline.purpose: The Reference detail entry title at clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.1rem); also the visual scale the monumental User Note lead borrows.

title.purpose: Reference card titles on the wall, empty-state headings, and dialog titles at 1.5rem / 1.06.

body.purpose: The reading face: the rendered User Note at 1.14rem / 1.62, base body at 17px / 1.55 with oldstyle numerals, the italic card clause, the italic search input, and the italic 'later hand' marginalia.

label.purpose: Every control, meta line, badge, caption, and definition list. Uppercase, letter-spaced 0.09em-0.18em, tabular-nums where figures align.

subhead.purpose: Young Serif section and empty-state headings.

note-lead.purpose: The User Note opening clause, Spectral italic 600 in cobalt at poster scale — the one place colour goes bold in prose.

clause.purpose: The card clause and the AI-interpretation marginalia, Spectral italic.

label-xs.purpose: Segmented controls, tag chips, sort/view toggles, page footers.

shadows.name: shadow-plate
shadows.purpose: Resting cast shadow under a pinned plate. NOIR: 3px 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.5).

shadows.name: shadow-plate-lift
shadows.purpose: An ignited (hover/focus) plate and the modal dialog. NOIR: 6px 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.62).

shadows.name: shadow-pin
shadows.purpose: The radial-gradient pushpin disc. NOIR: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6).

shadows.name: plate-mat-ring
shadows.purpose: Layered after the cast shadow on every plate: the 6px paper mat plus a 1.5px ink keyline echo. Disliked plates swap the outer ring to color-mix(in srgb, var(--dislike) 35%, transparent).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible ring. On a plate the offset opens to 6px; pointer focus stays quiet via :focus:not(:focus-visible).

motion.name: plate-ignite
motion.purpose: The one authored moment. On hover/focus a plate straightens from its resting tilt to rotate(0), lifts translateY(-5px), and moves shadow-plate -> shadow-plate-lift.

motion.name: wall-dim
motion.purpose: Neighbours fall to context weight while one piece is ignited. Gated to @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

motion.name: clause-open
motion.purpose: The printed label's User Note clause opens from 3 to 9 lines when its piece ignites.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Loading plates while the server scans references/.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Full reduced-motion path: the ignite still straightens and opens the label, but with no animated transform or dim.

components.name: segmented-control
components.description: Buttons welded edge-to-edge inside one 2px ink frame, divided by 2px ink border-left. Active segment floods ink/ground; hover floods cyan. Used for the section nav, theme picker, and kind filter.

components.name: sentiment-toggle
components.description: The All / Liked / Disliked filter. Same welded-segment shape as the segmented control, but the active flood takes a semantic colour: Liked -> green with dark-ink text, Disliked -> red with white text.

components.name: tagchip
components.description: Aggregated tag facet. 2px ink box, mono-caps, square. Active floods ink/ground; hover (inactive) floods cyan.

components.name: field
components.description: The 'uncap the pen' field. No box — a single 2px cobalt bottom border on a panel (or transparent) element. Focus removes the outline and washes the field with cyan at 12%. Rows pair a 5.5rem mono uppercase label with the control.

components.name: plate
components.description: Signature component. A screenshot mounted as a pinned plate: cover-fit image on a panel-2 backing, 1.5px keyline edge, cast shadow + 6px paper mat ring, resting -1.3deg tilt, a radial-gradient pushpin at top. On hover/focus it straightens to rotate(0), lifts 5px, and goes to the lift shadow. Disliked swaps the edge to 2.5px red, the outer mat ring to red, and the pushpin gradient to red.

components.description: AI Interpretation as dated marginalia. A hanging-indent block set 2.75rem into the left margin, opened by a 1px dashed soft-ink rule, in Spectral italic soft-ink, under a mono uppercase cobalt-text header. Never overlaps or restyles the User Note above it.

narrative.northStar: The Connoisseur's Gallery. Browsing your own taste is wandering a gallery you hung, not scanning a feed. Every judged web experience is a pinned plate — a screenshot with a thin ink keyline, a 6px paper mat, a soft blurred cast shadow, a real radial-gradient pushpin, and a 1–2° tilt — tacked to a calm, bright wall and arranged left-to-right by how much you mean it. The surface is printed, not rendered: riso/silkscreen ink, hard rules, a fixed grain overlay. The governing instinct is rules and ink, never boxes.
narrative.overview: The personality is editorial and opinionated but never loud. Saturation is rationed: the wall ground stays quiet so screenshots and prose carry the contrast, and colour is spent only where it does work — the cobalt accent, the cyan hover, and the two theme-stable sentiment colours (green Liked, red Disliked). There are no card containers and no button chrome anywhere; structure is carried entirely by 2px ink rules, colour blocks, and a 3–4px sentiment ink-bar over each printed label. Corners are square throughout — the only curve in the whole system is the pushpin disc. Density is gallery-sparse, not dashboard-dense. Four columns of plates at desktop, hung at staggered heights, with generous air between rows (3.25rem / 1.875rem grid gaps). One authored motion carries the whole build: a piece ignites on hover or focus — it straightens, lifts ~5px, its label opens from 3 to 9 lines of the User Note, and the rest of the wall dims to context weight (~0.48). Everything else holds perfectly still. On the detail view, the exception to the colour discipline is deliberate: the User Note's opening clause is set at poster scale in saturated cobalt Spectral italic, because the Note is the whole point of the artefact.
keyCharacteristics: Rules and ink, never boxes. Hard 2px --ink rules divide; active state floods an element with ink; zero card or button containers.
Squared corners everywhere (0 radius). The pushpin disc and the 6px kind dot are the only curves in the system.
Every screenshot is a mounted plate — 1.5px ink keyline, 6px --panel mat, --shadow-plate cast shadow, radial-gradient pushpin, 1–2° tilt.
Plate size rides rating, never sentiment — triple-diamond 4:3, double 16:11, single / none 16:9. The wall stratifies by strength of feeling.
Sentiment is semantic and theme-stable — green = Liked, red = Disliked, in both themes, and the only strong colour permitted on a plate.
Three real faces, one job each — Young Serif (display), Spectral (the User Note), Spline Sans Mono (labels, meta, controls).
Riso/silkscreen grain — one fixed radial-dot overlay, multiply in SLATE, screen in NOIR.
One authored moment — a piece ignites on hover/focus while the wall dims; full prefers-reduced-motion path.
SLATE (light, default use scene) / NOIR (dark, answers the OS). Theme follows prefers-color-scheme; [data-theme] and ?theme= override.

rules.name: The Named-Role Rule
rules.body: Every colour is one of seven print roles — ground, panel, ink, accent, highlight, like, dislike — doing real work. No candy accents, no fourth hue, no colour without a job.

rules.name: The Sentiment-Is-Semantic Rule
rules.body: Green is Liked and red is Disliked, in both themes, always. Sentiment colour never shifts with the palette, and it is the only saturated colour allowed to touch a plate.

rules.name: The Ink-Not-Box Rule
rules.body: Selection and active states flood an element with --ink (or its sentiment colour) and reverse the text to --ground. They never draw a new border and never raise a shadow.

rules.name: The Three-Faces Rule
rules.body: Young Serif sets identity, Spectral speaks, Spline Sans Mono labels. A face never crosses into another face's job.

rules.name: The Monumental-Note Rule
rules.body: The User Note's opening clause is set at poster scale in Spectral italic 600, --accent-text — the single place colour goes bold in running prose. No other text ever gets this treatment.

rules.name: The Mono-Caps Rule
rules.body: Every control, meta line, badge, and caption is Spline Sans Mono, uppercase, letter-spaced at least 0.09em. Numbers in aligned contexts use tabular-nums; body prose uses oldstyle-nums.

rules.name: The Reading-Order Rule
rules.body: The wall is a left-to-right, row-by-row grid (4 → 2 → 1). The scattered-hang feel is per-column margin-top offset plus per-plate tilt only. DOM order always equals reading order.

rules.name: The Rating-Stratifies Rule
rules.body: Plate proportion is driven by rating alone (triple-diamond 4:3, double 16:11, single / none 16:9). Neither sentiment nor recency ever changes a plate's size.

rules.name: The Only-Plates-Lift Rule
rules.body: Cast shadows belong to pinned plates (and the one modal dialog) only. Labels, headblocks, bands, buttons, and fields are flat — separated by 2px rules and colour, never by shadow.

rules.name: The Ignite-Don't-Float Rule
rules.body: On hover/focus a plate moves from --shadow-plate to --shadow-plate-lift and translateY(-5px) while straightening to rotate(0). That is the entire elevation change in the product; there is no resting hover-float and no parallax.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: Every corner is square. The pushpin disc and the kind dot are the only permitted curves — introducing border-radius anywhere else breaks the print world.

rules.name: The Rule-Weight Rule
rules.body: Structural divisions are 2px solid --ink; plate edges are 1.5px --keyline; sentiment bars are 3–4px; anything derived or secondary is 1px dashed --ink-soft. Weights are not mixed arbitrarily.

dos: Do keep the wall ground calm (--ground) so screenshots and prose carry the contrast — spend saturation only on ink, labels, sentiment, and the cobalt accent.
Do divide with a hard 2px --ink rule.
Do flood active controls with --ink (or the sentiment colour) and reverse the text to --ground.
Do give every screenshot the full plate treatment: 1.5px --keyline edge, 6px --panel mat, --shadow-plate, a pushpin, and a 1–2° tilt.
Do size plates from rating only (triple-diamond 4:3, double 16:11, single / none 16:9).
Do mark a Disliked piece with exactly a red keyline + red pushpin + thumb-down, inline on the same wall.
Do keep every corner square (0 radius).
Do set the User Note lead at poster scale in cobalt Spectral italic 600.
Do keep AI Interpretation visually subordinate — 1px dashed rule, muted ink, 2.75rem margin indent, dated mono header.
Do keep the segmented look literal: buttons welded inside one 2px frame, divided by 2px border-left, no gaps, no outer radius.
Do ship exactly one authored motion — the ignite (straighten + lift + label-open + wall-dim to ~0.48) — and gate the wall-dim to (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
Do write every control, meta line, and badge in Spline Sans Mono, uppercase, tracked at least 0.09em.
Do write TasteVault as one word, capital T and V, with Vault in --accent.
donts: Don't add a fourth hue or a decorative accent. kind is a 6px palette-derived dot, never a fill and never a new colour.
Don't wrap anything in a bordered or rounded card — the label and headblock are printed panels with a top ink-bar, not boxes.
Don't outline an active control or give it a drop shadow.
Don't render a bare image, a zero-tilt plate, or a plate without a pushpin.
Don't let sentiment or recency change a plate's size.
Don't add a corner chip, or dim / hide / silo a Disliked piece — the corner chip was tried and rejected for drowning the positives.
Don't introduce border-radius anywhere except the pushpin disc and the kind dot.
Don't apply the colour-in-prose treatment to any text other than the User Note lead, and don't colour the User Note body.
Don't let the 'later hand' touch, overlap, or restyle the User Note.
Don't space segment buttons apart or round the group.
Don't add incidental transitions, entrance animations, parallax, or a resting hover-float; honour prefers-reduced-motion by dropping the transform.
Don't introduce a sans-serif anywhere, and don't set body prose in anything but Spectral.
Don't describe the Portal by comparison to any other product.
